fields.description: 16-byte ASCII save header 'PIA33DATA040212' plus NUL terminator; coherent only in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.evidence: Baseline logical bytes 0x00..0x0F read back via the FUN_08106388 EEPROM-read path (8-byte blocks through FUN_08106308 DMA to 0x0D000000); raw file bytes are bit-reversed per 8-byte block so eeprom_rev8 is true.
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: Slot 0 record tag byte; first byte of the 0x90-stride record array starting at logical 0x158 (value 0x03 in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_08106388 reads one 8-byte EEPROM block per call (4x u16 rebuilt at param_2+6) and FUN_081065ac verifies 4 shorts per call; record base 0x158 is block-aligned start of slot 0 in the 16-record array.
fields.name: slot00_state

fields.description: Slot 0 four route/unlock flag bytes (baseline 01 01 01 01, LE32 0x01010101).
fields.evidence: Logical bytes 0x15B..0x15E inside the slot-0 record written by the FUN_0810644c EEPROM-write path (bit-serialised words via FUN_08106308 to 0x0D000000) and verified word-wise by FUN_081065ac.
fields.name: slot00_route_flags

fields.description: Slot 0 progress counter byte at record offset +0x37 (value 0x06 in baseline).
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x18F = slot-0 base 0x158 + 0x37; persisted through the FUN_0810644c write / FUN_08106388 read pair, single nonzero byte amid zero padding.
fields.name: slot00_progress_count

fields.description: Slot 1 record tag byte; second entry of the 0x90-stride record array at logical 0x1E8 (value 0x03, identical default to slot 0).
fields.evidence: Same FUN_08106388 8-byte-block read / FUN_0810644c write path as slot00_state; stride 0x1E8 - 0x158 = 0x90 matches the 16-record array spacing.
fields.name: slot01_state

fields.description: Slot 1 four route/unlock flag bytes (baseline 01 01 01 01, mirrors slot 0 defaults).
fields.evidence: Logical bytes 0x1EB..0x1EE inside the slot-1 record; same FUN_0810644c bit-serialised write and FUN_081065ac 4-short verify path as slot00_route_flags.
fields.name: slot01_route_flags

fields.description: Slot 1 progress counter byte at record offset +0x37 (value 0x06 in baseline).
fields.evidence: Logical offset 0x21F = slot-1 base 0x1E8 + 0x37; persisted through the FUN_0810644c write / FUN_08106388 read pair.
fields.name: slot01_progress_count

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'PIA3' header in the rev8-logical domain
